title: UI: Scene switcher panel
description: Add scene management UI to Shell.tsx. Flash 8 has a scene panel that shows all scenes in a list, allows clicking to switch scenes, add/delete/reorder scenes. Implement as a small panel or tab showing: current scene highlighted, list of scenes, + button to add scene, ✕ to delete, drag handles to reorder. Use addSceneToDoc, deleteScene, reorderScene, renameSceneInDoc from @flash/core. Wire activeSceneIndex state to scene switching. Keep it minimal but functional. Build must pass.
